snippet.title: Verho - Curse of Faces | Chaos Content Update & Console Release Teaser
snippet.description:
"In a world where revealing one's face means instant death, the mask has become a symbol of safety. Will you strive to lift the curse from the world, or will you harness its power for your ends?
The choice is yours."

Verho is a dark-fantasy RPG following the tradition of classics of the genre like King's Field. 

Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017330/Verho/

July 30th on consoles:
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/de-DE/games/store/verho-curse-of-faces/9PNLRX1MZ64C
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/de-de/concept/10018501
Nintendo Switch: Soon
